question: Which of the following layers of the atmosphere is most liable for the greenhouse effect?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Troposphere**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Troposphere **- 

 
 
• 
 The layer of the atmosphere most responsible for the greenhouse effect is the troposphere. 
 
 
• 
 The troposphere is the lowest layer of the Earth's atmosphere, extending from the Earth's surface up to about 8 kilometers (5 miles) at the poles and about 18 kilometers (11 miles) at the equator. 
 
 
• 
 This layer contains approximately 75% of the atmosphere's mass and is where most of the Earth's weather takes place. It's also where the majority of the gases responsible for the greenhouse effect are found.
